reference: No DOS6 bios/rapiopen.asm or rapi* homolog found. This target-specific registry module is reviewed against Microsoft assembly module/procedure/segment conventions; no false whole-file correspondence is claimed.
changes: Replace fifteen stale per-file provenance/verification header blocks at the top with one module contract. Add purpose and actual stack-argument comments to each of the fifteen procedures; normalize declarations and instruction indentation. Preserve original instruction spelling, offsets and generated branch labels for binary traceability.
necessity: The file already consolidates open/close/query/create/delete/set/enumeration/flush/mount/save APIs in one REGAPI compilation unit. No additional split files required. RegVMEntry selects a Windows provider at runtime, while local operation is needed without that provider; these are required modes, not redundant DOS-version branches. Local calls share validation, path, file-reference and record providers. Preserve instruction-level similarities in open/create and mount/save to retain target stack paths and layout.
